summary: {person} can visit one staffed site while a larger service proposal is still being tested.
realLife: Seattle’s parks department began a participatory-budgeting pilot with staff at the Cal Anderson Park restrooms in 2025.
gates: An approved pilot location and an actual staffing roster.
weights: A pending expansion decision makes a site visit more timely.
inGame: needs: pilot authorization, staff hours, visitor counts by time and site.

turns.what: The board asks what a second site would cost.
turns.pulledBy: The staffed hours cover the busiest visits.

turns.what: The manager proposes a different shift.
turns.pulledBy: The busiest hours fall outside the pilot.
turns.writesBack: Revise the trial schedule before evaluating it.
